title: gx checks
description: A project's .gx/checks.json (or the checks key of project.json): the commands `gx check` runs. {files} in a command is replaced by the selected files.

check.description: A command for both scopes, false to turn the kind off, or a pair of commands.

changed.description: Command for a changed-files run. Absent: the gx default.

full.description: Command for a --full run, with {files} set to every tracked file.
